title: isolepis hystrix
intro: Isolepis hystrix, commonly known as the Rough Club-sedge, is a type of flowering plant in the sedge family (Cyperaceae). It is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Isolepis hystrix include its antispasmodic, diuretic, and expectorant properties, which can be used to relieve symptoms of respiratory issues and digestive problems. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
